raw:
@q query
  mode count
  select ?c
  where all
    match
      relation "be born in"
      role subject ?c
      role location "Ruginoasa"
      role time "this year"
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "be the twin of"
      role subject ?c
      role object "Ionuț Axinte"
      polarity negated
    end
  end
